newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gov't says Spain will be part of single currency.
newsitem.headline: Gov't says Spain will be part of single currency.

text.p: Spain will meet the Maastricht criteria for European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) from the outset of the project, a government spokesman said on Friday.
"Spain will meet Maastricht criteria and..if Spain meets the requirements, Spain will be in EMU and no-one can stop it," Miguel Angel Rodriguez said after today's cabinet meeting.

Rodriguez said Spain already meets the goals in terms of interest rates, while it will meet the deficit target in 1997. However he added that it does not meet the inflation goal, which is still 0.4 percentage points above the required target.
Inflation was 3.2 percent year-on-year in December 1996.
